tools.output_contract: { description: str, change_map_ref: str|null, regions: Region[], indices: IndexChange[], score: float }

allowed_parameters.name: noise_sigma
allowed_parameters.description: Robust sigma multiplier setting the noise floor a pixel must clear to count as changed. Higher is more conservative.

allowed_parameters.name: min_region_pixels
allowed_parameters.description: Smallest connected changed region kept; smaller ones are treated as noise.

allowed_parameters.name: min_changed_fraction
allowed_parameters.description: Share of the shared area that must change before a change claim is reported.

tools.training_dataset: none - the detector is algorithmic, not trained
limitations: Detects radiometric change; it does not classify what kind of change occurred.
Requires both dates in the same modality - optical vs SAR is refused.
NDVI/NDWI are only computed when the raster declares its band roles.
Reports inconclusive when the pair is misregistered by more than one pixel.

tools.input_contract: { t1_image_id: str, t2_image_id: str, question: str }
tools.output_contract: { answer: str, score: float, evidence: Evidence[] }

allowed_parameters.name: noise_sigma
allowed_parameters.description: Robust sigma multiplier setting the noise floor a pixel must clear to count as changed. Higher is more conservative.

allowed_parameters.name: min_region_pixels
allowed_parameters.description: Smallest connected changed region kept; smaller ones are treated as noise.

tools.training_dataset: none - answers are derived from measurements, not generated
tools.benchmark_status: not benchmarked; CDVQA evaluation is Phase 9
limitations: Answers only questions the measurement supports: occurrence, location, extent, and NDVI/NDWI direction. Anything else returns a stated limitation.
No built-up/urban classifier exists, so construction is never confirmed.
Vegetation and water trends need declared band roles; otherwise it declines.

tools.name: ChangeVQA (trained classifier, CDVQA)
tools.input_contract: { t1_image_id: str, t2_image_id: str, question: str }
tools.output_contract: { answer: str, score: float, evidence: Evidence[] }
tools.license: Model: MIT (this project). Training data: CDVQA (research use) + SECOND.
tools.training_dataset: CDVQA questions + SECOND imagery (train split only)
tools.training_method: frozen CLIP features + trained GRU question encoder + fusion classifier
tools.benchmark_status: CDVQA held-out Test acc 0.71 / Test2 0.66 (see reports/benchmarks/cdvqa)
limitations: Trained on SECOND 0.1524 m aerial imagery; benefit on other sensors/resolutions (e.g. Sentinel) is not established.
Closed 19-answer vocabulary from CDVQA; cannot answer outside it.
Weakest on counting/ratio questions (smallest_change ~0.32); confidence is an uncalibrated softmax.
Not the default route; the deterministic detector is used for general imagery.

tools.name: LearnedChange (Siamese U-Net, SECOND)
tools.output_contract: { answer: str, score: float, evidence: Evidence[] }
tools.license: Model: MIT (this project). Training data: SECOND (additional public dataset).
tools.training_dataset: SECOND train split (binary change derived from semantic labels)
limitations: Binary change only (changed vs unchanged); not from-to semantic class.
Trained on SECOND 0.1524 m aerial RGB; generalization to other sensors/resolutions not established.
Held-out split is an internal split of the provided train set, not the official SECOND test set.
Not the default route; the deterministic CVA is used for general imagery.

tools.name: OpticalSARFusion (cross-modal, feature-level)
tools.input_contract: { optical_image_id: str, sar_image_id: str, question: str|null }
tools.output_contract: { answer: str, evidence: Evidence[], complementarity: float|null, regions: Region[], score: float }
tools.training_dataset: none - the analysis is algorithmic, not trained
limitations: Requires exactly one optical and one SAR image of the same area; refuses otherwise.
SAR is treated as log-scaled, uncalibrated backscatter unless metadata declares calibration; sigma0/gamma0 is never assumed.
Reports measured backscatter/roughness for SAR, not semantic land-cover classes.
NDVI/NDWI and optical-SAR water agreement need the optical raster to declare bands.
The optional land-cover reading is optical-only, zero-shot, and indicative.

allowed_parameters.name: max_preview_side
allowed_parameters.description: Longest side of the rendered preview in pixels.
